thread:
michael: Quick alert — during private-deploy validation control-plane lost outbound to vendor KMS for ~2m and we fell back to the in-cluster HSM shim. Need an auditable artifact and a short RBAC review.

 tara: Can you paste the control-plane/audit-forwarder snippets? Was anything dropped or truncated?

 michael: logs below — control-plane switched to shim and forwarder started spooling.
```
kubectl -n redwood-control logs cp-0 --since=5m | grep -i kms
2026-06-10T15:12:07Z WARN dial tcp 198.51.100.12:443: connection reset
2026-06-10T15:12:15Z INFO routing: using hsm-shim.cluster.local:15001
2026-06-10T15:13:40Z INFO audit: enqueued 314 events -> forwarder spool
```

 owen: netops graphs show a conntrack spike at the same minute and the cluster uses default-deny egress. Forwarder buffered ~420 events, buffer_write_failures=0, no dropped events.

 tara: Compliance asks for: 1) signed audit bundle (tar.gz + SHA256 manifest + detached sig), 2) rolebinding snapshot for hsm-shim SA, 3) list of key IDs referenced during handoff, 4) a short attestation that no plaintext key material left the cluster.

 michael: I'll drain the forwarder spool -> bundle, generate manifest and gpg --detach-sign, and redact nonces but keep key refs. key id used: hk-c4d.

 owen: Mitigation plan: do NOT open wide egress. Instead apply a narrow NetworkPolicy to force control-plane to proxy KMS traffic to the shim svc. Example snippet: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: cp-force-shim-egress-temp
  namespace: redwood-control
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: control-plane
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: hsm-shim
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 15001
```

 security-bot: Created ticket RW-SEC-5222: "private-deploy KMS fallback: audit bundle + RBAC/netpol actions" assigned to @tara and @michael. ETA 24h.

 tara: Postmortem actions: add alert (audit-forwarder buffer > 300), require SBOM+vuln-scan for any shim image before acceptance, add OPA rule to deny exec/port-forward for system:serviceaccount:redwood-control:hsm-shim.

 michael: Uploaded signed bundle to s3://redwood-compliance/2026-06-10/5222 (manifest + detached sig + rolebindings + SBOM hash). Reverting to vendor KMS endpoint and monitoring for recurrence. :thumbsup:
